treasures.name: Golden Compass
treasures.effect: Draw 2 cards at the start of your turn.

treasures.name: Crystal of Power
treasures.effect: Your Gene Pool cannot be reduced below 5.

treasures.name: Ancient Relic
treasures.effect: At World's End: +2 for each trait in your trait pile.

treasures.name: Mystic Orb
treasures.effect: When you play a Dominant, draw 3 cards.

magicalMerchants.name: Merchant of Dreams
magicalMerchants.action: Look at the top 3 cards of the deck.

glitterlings.name: Lucky Sparkle
glitterlings.effect: Roll a die: 1-3: Draw 1 card, 4-6: Draw 2 cards.
glitterlings.action: Random effect: 50% chance to play another trait.

glitterlings.name: Chaos Shimmer
glitterlings.effect: All players draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.

moonlings.name: Lunar Phase
moonlings.effect: Give 1 card from your hand to an opponent.
moonlings.action: If your Gene Pool is 5 or lower, draw 2 cards.

moonlings.name: Night Walker
moonlings.effect: Opponents with higher Gene Pool than you discard 1 card.
moonlings.action: +1 for each opponent with higher Gene Pool.

deeplings.name: Deep Suppressor
deeplings.action: Suppressed cards are worth +1 point each.

deeplings.name: Abyssal Form
deeplings.effect: Suppress up to 2 cards from your trait pile.
deeplings.action: Draw 1 card for each card suppressed this way.

fuzelings.name: Fusion Burst
fuzelings.effect: Combine effects of Deeplings, Moonlings, and Glitterlings in play.
fuzelings.action: Trigger random effect from each expansion type you have.

fuzelings.name: Chaotic Blend
fuzelings.effect: Double all Drop of Life bonuses this turn.
fuzelings.action: May trigger combo effects from mixed expansion traits.

newTraits.name: Temporal Rift
newTraits.effect: Take an extra turn after this one.

newTraits.name: Genetic Amplifier
newTraits.effect: Double the face value of the next trait you play.
newTraits.action: May play an additional trait this turn.

newCatastrophes.name: The Great Reset
newCatastrophes.effect: All players shuffle their trait piles into the deck and draw 5 new cards.
newCatastrophes.worldsEnd: Gene Pools reset to 8. All Dominants return to hand.

newCatastrophes.name: Reality Storm
newCatastrophes.worldsEnd: Random redistribution of all trait piles among players.

newCatastrophes.name: Void Collapse
newCatastrophes.effect: All suppressed cards are permanently removed from the game.
newCatastrophes.worldsEnd: Deepling players gain +3 points for each card they had suppressed.

newAges.name: Age of Wonders
newAges.description: Treasure effects are doubled. All players may draw an extra card.

newAges.name: Merchant Renaissance
newAges.description: Trinket trading is free. Merchants may activate twice per turn.

newAges.name: The Convergence
newAges.description: All expansion effects can trigger regardless of card type.

newAges.name: Dimensional Shift
newAges.description: Players may choose to play cards from the suppression pile as if they were in hand.
